description: One rival of your app in one storefront: its name, rating and rating count with a 90-day history of them (a name change is how a listing rewrite shows), and the keywords it ranks for with its rank on each. The keyword list uses one keyword spy from the monthly allowance and stays open for 30 days; when the allowance is used up the answer carries the rival's own figures with `locked: true`.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

name: get_rival_detail
